notes:
Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood. Started with Hosted API POC (Jan 15). Trial results encouraging for embeddings + chat assist; now sizing Dedicated for predictable latency and compliance.

Trial metrics (hosted API):
- Avg QPS during peak 11–14; sustained 6–8 QPS during daytime; spikes to 22 for batch re-index jobs.
- Observed concurrency (simultaneous in-flight tokens): typically 3–5 per VM; POC sim accounted for 12 concurrent user sessions.
- Token mix (approx): 65% short prompts (<=64 tokens), 30% medium (65–512), 5% long (>=512) during product search+summaries.
- Per-request latency target: 150–250ms p50 for chat replies; p95 < 800ms. Current hosted p50 ~180ms (good), p95 ~950ms (need improvement for SLA).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; aim to lower token cost by ~40% vs hosted over time via quantized models + batching.

Requirements voiced by product + infra: 
- Deterministic p95 SLOs for search & support flows; can tolerate higher latency for async batch reranks.
- Data residency: primary US region; audit logs + KMS for embeddings storage.
- SSO/SAML integration for admin console; RBAC for model rollout controls.

POC ask for Dedicated sizing:
- Estimate baseline QPS 10 sustained, burst to 30 for daily re-index window (15m).
- Concurrency: target headroom for 25 concurrent inferences of median token length 120.
- Token mix for pricing model: use POC distribution above; include 20% growth buffer over 6 months.

Commercial & buying signals: 
- Procurement timeline: Apr 2026 (security review + procurement).
- Stakeholders: VP Product (Claire Denton), Head of Infra (Ravi Kulkarni), CTO (Marta Lin).
- Budget indicated: comfortable with reserved monthly commit if ROI shows 35–45% unit-cost reduction.
